title: really excited for @MACHINAL the play and my LAST play of the season!...
transcript: Hello from Times Square, where I'm having a very theater filled Wednesday. I just went to the press preview for New York Theater Company's premiere show. They're doing an adaptation of the play Machinal, but it's the French pronunciation, so it's Machinal. They're adding this very cool, very interesting tap component. Still a play, but like a tap movement piece. I'll do a full video, but first I'll share some clips right now. Sleep till 10, sleep till noon. Now you have a good rest this morning. Don't get up until you want to. Oh, thank you. Oh, don't. Please don't touch me. So cool, right? Like, I cannot wait to see the full show. And then this is the maybe happy ending. Mocha from the drum book shop. Best place in the city. Always great coffee, always theater themed. I love this. It's like a chocolate strawberry thing. It's delicious. And then now I'm headed uptown for a 1 p m. Matinee. It's an obvious. I took today off of work to finish out my Broadway season. My first show is a play with five Tony nominations, very famous celebrity lead, and is an adaptation of a movie reveal. In 3, 2, 1, it's good night and good luck with George Clooney. My last play of the season. Kind of cool going in. See you after the show.
classificationReason: Day-vlog revealing she is heading into the Good Night and Good Luck matinee; no opinion on the production yet. Machinal press preview (not on list) and Maybe Happy Ending (mentioned only as a coffee drink) are incidental.
